prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic 4:5 bedroom mirror selfie with comic-inspired athletic styling.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult athletic woman with shoulder-length natural waves, center part, warm complexion, natural soft-glam makeup, and relaxed confident smile, wearing a fitted opaque long-sleeve red-and-navy athletic suit with a generic spider-inspired web motif and full-coverage lower section.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered mid-thigh-to-head mirror selfie, modern phone in hand, ornate full-length mirror, cream upholstered bed, beige textured bedding, white pillows, sheer curtains and warm-toned walls.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural window light with warm golden ambient tones, calm cozy luxury bedroom, gentle fabric highlights and diffused shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame DSLR 85mm f/1.8 look, f/2.2, 4:5 vertical, shallow depth, natural skin and web-pattern detail, high dynamic range.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-realistic 4:5 mirror selfie portrait of an approved adult athletic woman with shoulder-length natural loose waves, center part, warm light complexion, natural soft-glam makeup, and a relaxed confident smile directed toward the phone screen. She wears a fitted opaque long-sleeve red-and-navy athletic suit with a generic spider-inspired web motif and full-coverage lower section. Frame her from mid-thigh to head in an ornate full-length mirror, with a cream upholstered bed, beige textured bedspread, white pillows, sheer curtains, and warm-toned walls behind. Use soft natural window light, warm golden ambient tones, 85mm f/1.8 DSLR look, f/2.2, gentle shadows, realistic skin, fabric and web detail.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, high-cut legs, exposed hips, latex, sexualized bodysuit, body emphasis, nudity, trademark superhero logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, bedroom, mirror, bed, palette and superhero-inspired motif; use a generic motif without trademark emblem, with opaque full coverage. Keep typography absent.

changes: Replaced high-cut body suit and trademark emblem with an opaque full-coverage athletic suit and generic spider-inspired motif while preserving the character-fashion concept.
